title: eaw-fwrestling-australian-national
label: John "Mad Dog" Murphy

won.source: The fed's own Champions page: "Date Won: Thursday, May 1st 2008 / Event: EAW Mayhem / Match: Four Corners 30 Minute Iron Man Match" (promotions/eaw-fwrestling/archive/champions-2008.html), corroborated by the fed's own 10 April 2008 newsdesk naming the four Four Corners qualifiers (promotions/eaw-fwrestling/archive/news-2008-04-10-contenders-decided.html).

how: Won EAW's own first Australian National Heavyweight Championship in a Four Corners 30 Minute Iron Man Match at EAW Mayhem against Matt Carter, Santino Romano and Bryan Willett — the four qualifiers from Outback Thunder's own tournament matches.
note: EAW Mayhem, the show this reign was won on, is not among the held record's served documents — only referenced by the fed's own later pages. Still champion as of the fed's own last dated content (17 July 2008).
